::: {#rem-racket-divides}
#### Divisibility in Racket

For a nonzero integer $a$, $a \mid b$ exactly when dividing $b$ by $a$ leaves remainder $0$.
In Racket,
`(zero? (remainder 12 3))` returns `#t`
and `(zero? (remainder 13 3))` returns `#f`,
as in @exm-divides.
`(remainder 12 0)` raises an error,
so a Racket test of $a \mid b$ has to handle $a = 0$ on its own.

:::
